description: This file defines the Home page component of a React-based web application. It manages state for recipe tags, selected filters, and recipe data, and renders child components for filtering and displaying recipes. It also performs side effects such as fetching available tags and recipes based on user interaction.

methods.name: Home()
methods.description: React functional component serving as the home page, displaying recipe filters and recipe grid with dynamic data fetching based on user-selected tags.
